Investigate the battle Olfun heard for signs of the Ebon Vanguard.
==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Discover the fate of the [[Ebon Vanguard]].
* Search [[Grothmar Wardowns]] for signs of the Vanguard.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Vanguard reputation point]]s

==Walkthrough==
After exiting Longeye's Ledge, head southeast down the path to find the [[Vanguard Helmet]]. Examine it to complete the quest.

If you instead see the [[Tattered Vanguard Clothing]], head south from there to find the Vanguard Helmet; alternatively if you find the [[Old Campfire]], head east instead. Interacting with either the clothing or the campfire are not necessary to complete the quest.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Olfun Longeye
:''What's that? The '''Ebon Vanguard'''? That rag-tag bunch of [[human]]s passed through here not too long ago, muttering something about fighting Charr. I've got no problem with that just so long as they don't do it here.

:''I heard some '''fighting''' downhill a few nights ago '''southeast''' of here. From what I heard, it was a large battle. Keep your eyes open; it's likely you'll find some gear and weapons you can scavenge. If you find a nice axe, let me know.''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Thank you for the information. We'll focus our search to the southeast, and keep our eyes open.
|decline = I think we'll make camp here for a while. You have a nice view.
|ask = I told you all I know, human. If your '''Vanguard''' was in that battle, you'll find where they fought to '''the southeast'''. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Vanguard Helmet
:''You can tell a great battle took place on this spot. Below you is a battered and broken Vanguard helmet. The Ebon Vanguard definitely fought here. You should examine the helmet more closely.''

==Notes==
*Be sure to let each member of your team complete the quest before you begin the next step or they will not receive credit for the mini mission.
*If you do examine the helmet more closely, you will automatically start the next primary quest in the Ebon Vanguard chain, [[Against the Charr]].
